content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What is the group revenue forecast for the next 6 months?

content.statement:
WITH __forecast AS (
  SELECT
    year_month AS fc_year_month,
    series,
    value_type,
    backtest_mape,
    revenue_inr AS fc_revenue_inr,
    lower_bound_inr,
    upper_bound_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_FORECAST
)
SELECT
  fc_year_month AS month,
  fc_revenue_inr AS forecast_inr,
  lower_bound_inr,
  upper_bound_inr,
  backtest_mape
FROM __forecast
WHERE
  series = 'GROUP' AND value_type = 'FORECAST'
ORDER BY
  fc_year_month
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 785cf4b5-ab0c-4b1f-8d68-13b9a464db17)
;
